body.name: Predeclared-minor canonical stopped-law realization
body.construction: For \(\mathcal U=(u_1,\ldots,u_K)\) with \(u_1=\epsilon\) and \(\mathcal V=((w_1,b_1),\ldots,(w_K,b_K))\), set \(H_{\mathcal U,\mathcal V}[i,j]=F_{b_j}(u_iw_j)\) and \(H_a[i,j]=F_{b_j}(u_i a w_j)\). On \(\mathcal M^{\mathrm{HL}}_{K,T}(\mathcal U,\mathcal V)\), set \(\bar M_a=H_{\mathcal U,\mathcal V}^{-1}H_a\), \(\bar\alpha\) equal to the empty-prefix coordinate row, \(\bar v=H_{\mathcal U,\mathcal V}^{-1}f_R\), and \(\bar h=H_{\mathcal U,\mathcal V}^{-1}f_A\), where \(f_R,f_A\) are the corresponding risk and adoption terminal columns.
